Your Personal Wellness Operating System

Overview Instructions I. Vision & Objectives II. Strategy III. Tracking IV. Education

🌿Welcome to Your Personal Wellness Operating System, Powered by La Vie de Zee.

Exercise stewardship over your life by enhancing your health, organizing your efforts, and serving from a place of vibrant abundance. This Operating System is engineered to help you become the architect of your wellness lifestyle. By guiding you to state your objectives, clarify your approach, and refine your inputs, this space is where discipline transforms into capacity.

This is a faith-led process created through a Christian framework, predicated on the idea of enlisting divine help to assist you in achieving your goals. Pray, meditate, or sit in silence before engaging with this tool and ask God to help you reach your goals.

Getting Started

Program Overview

How this Operating System works

🛣️ Roadmap: The goal of the Wellness Operating System is to move you through each stage necessary to achieve your wellness goals, as modeled by a Biblical framework. You will progress through three primary phases: ideation, actualization, and tracking. You will begin by clarifying your vision and objectives, proceed to planning and executing your wellness action steps, and conclude by monitoring your progress.

⏲️ Time Investment: Expect to invest 3–5 minutes per day initializing your layout in the morning and closing out your audit metrics at night.

📲 Mobile Execution: For maximum agility, bookmark this page to your phone’s home screen for one-tap access on the go, and enable notifications for anything you schedule elsewhere as reminders.

Before You Begin

Instructions

This Wellness Operating System is more than a mere organizational system. It is meant to act as a virtual Tabernacle, allowing you to move closer to God so that He can hear your prayers. Before we approach God with our requests, it is beneficial to align with His will and be open to His intercession.

The Sauce 🥫: How to Get Closer to God
  1. Cleanse yourself of outward, worldly sin. This can include low-quality media consumption, bad company, gossip, etc. As you spend more time in prayer, aligned action and scripture study, your discernment will improve, and it will become easier to notice unaligned elements in your life.
  2. Offer up something you engage in as a result of indwelling sin. These are the things that come from within us that block our connection with God. God asks us to love Him with all of our heart, all of our soul and all of our strength (Deuteronomy 6:5, Mark 12:30, Luke 10:27). This step requires radical honesty and a functional time audit. Some common examples include giving up emotional coping habits like excess sugar, excess social media use, or restrictive eating. These habits fill a void in our heart, so it’s necessary to ask Jesus to come and fill that void instead for true healing, rather than trying to white-knuckle through it alone.
  3. Accept the power you have to connect with God via your intuition and discernment, as well as the power to resist against the forces of evil. You’re not alone in your journey to create change — Jesus is with you at all times (Matthew 28:20). Make sure to call on Him.
  4. Take aligned action towards what is revealed to you. More on this below.
Section I

Vision Alignment & Objectives

Consider Your Wellness Goals: What Are They? 🧐

“Wellness” is a catch-all term that describes an overall state of wellbeing. For most people, this state can be distilled down into five core pillars:

Spiritual
Physical
Mental
Emotional
Social

This tony, oceanside slip of sand caters to those looking for luxe, waterfront wellness with a hushed, high-end aesthetic—think energy work and sound baths overlooking the Intracoastal.

The traditional heart of Miami's wellness scene, home to opulent hotel spas offering everything from indigenous earth rituals to aquatic bodywork.

Overseen directly by Dr. Carlos De La Hoz, MD — a triple board-certified physician — this clinic pairs physician-guided IV and ozone therapy with peptide-driven tissue repair for a genuinely diagnostic approach to recovery.

USA Sports Medicine - Aventura

Set just behind Aventura Hospital, this sports recovery clinic leans into neurofunctional acupuncture and active release technique for athletes focused on functional alignment over general relaxation.

Ideal Medical and Wellness

This concierge medical boutique's specialty is a doctor-formulated IV blend built specifically for muscle recovery, paired with B-12 and glutathione injections and personal optimization coaching.

Bal Harbour/Surfside/North Miami Beach

The Spa at Carillon Miami Wellness Resort

This 70,000-square-foot beachfront sanctuary is one of the few spots in Miami combining full HBOT and cryotherapy with touchless biohacking mats — a genuinely rare pairing of resort-scale luxury and high-tech recovery.

The Spa at St. Regis Bal Harbour

Five-star oceanfront luxury with a hands-on approach: think premium lymphatic drainage, sports massage and a full thermal circuit rather than tech-forward modalities.

ASR Sports Medicine (Bal Harbour, Brickell, Miami Beach)

An orthopedic and sports recovery clinic favored by professional athletes, offering neurofunctional acupuncture and structured corrective manual therapy for precise physical restoration.

Nex Performance and Rehab

Every recovery session here is run directly by a Doctor of Physical Therapy, including blood flow restriction recovery work — a technique that's still fairly niche outside elite athletic circles.

Atlantic Rehabilitation Center (North Miami Beach, Pembrook Pines, Daive)

A large, evidence-based sports medicine clinic built for structural tissue repair, notably offering Class IV laser tissue regeneration alongside spinal decompression.

The Biohack Lab

The Biohack Lab has a number of locations around Miami including an outpost in Sole Mia nestled within Reserve Padel. A genuinely rare pairing of court time and cellular recovery under one roof, ideal for pickleball and padel players looking to recover on-site.

Brickell/Downtown Miami

Healthspan

Housed inside the Four Seasons Tower on Brickell Avenue, this ultra-premium athletic optimization clinic is heavily performance-focused, targeting systemic inflammation with HBOT, whole-body cryotherapy and PEMF therapy mats.

Casa Privée

This highly exclusive concierge clinic is led by licensed physicians and specialists, offering medical-grade hyperbaric chamber therapy and doctor-formulated IV drips for advanced post-injury and athletic recovery.

Alive Miami

A premium longevity clinic owned and operated by Mount Sinai Internal Medicine physicians, delivering doctor-supervised IV drips, red light therapy and compression therapy with real clinical backing.

Pause Brickell

A modern lifestyle recovery studio that blends the "girlie" aesthetic with elite recovery tech — sensory deprivation float tanks, contrast therapy and whole-body cryotherapy included.

The Ice Room

A sleek, luxury sports recovery lounge designed like a high-end retreat, pairing whole-body cryotherapy and cold plunges with specialized deep tissue recovery work.

Centner Wellness - Brickell

Centner Wellness brings its signature detox-meets-high-tech-recovery approach to Brickell, with advanced infrared saunas, full-body cryotherapy and custom vitamin-infused IV drips.

Club Studio & Kalologie Medspa

A massive wellness pavilion inside Miami Worldcenter that pairs an expansive training floor with an integrated, advanced medical recovery spa — including cryotherapy chambers and specialized post-workout recovery zones.

Coconut Grove/Coral Gables

Centner Wellness - Coral Gables

This breathtaking biohacking oasis is one of the only spots on our list offering a Hocatt PEMF Ozone Sauna and a Vemi Acoustic Bed — genuinely distinctive modalities alongside their private Epsom salt float tanks.

BēAtala Wellness Spa

A deeply therapeutic bodywork sanctuary in the heart of Coconut Grove, highly favored by professional athletes for its 90-minute sports massage and precision anatomical restoration.

Ombright Wellness Acupuncture

Directed by Dr. Monika Olbrycht, LAc, DAOM — a highly acclaimed Doctor of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine — this clinical-holistic practice focuses on neurofunctional alignment and pain management.

Pure Health Miami

An ultra-private concierge longevity institute overseen by clinical medical doctors, specializing in doctor-formulated IV therapy and anti-aging peptide tissue repair.

The Biohack Lab - Coral Gables

The Coral Gables outpost of this cellular-repair-focused clinic brings the brand's signature cryotherapy and medical-grade IV drips to the Gables corridor.

Key Biscayne/Virginia Key

Key Basis IV & Wellness - Key Biscayne

Beyond their physical locations across Brickell's luxury towers, this concierge team also deploys premium clinical setups straight to yachts, private tennis clubs or homes on Key Biscayne.

HBOT Key Biscayne

This clinical environment is dedicated exclusively to hyperbaric oxygen therapy — no general relaxation offerings here, just clinical-strength pressurized chambers built to maximize oxygen saturation.

Note: This neighborhood cluster currently has 2 listed businesses rather than our usual 5, after removing Zativa Life, Fit Recovery Therapy, and relocating Key Biscayne Physical Therapy to South Miami/Pinecrest (renamed Pinecrest Physical Therapy). Flagged for a future pass to find replacements.

Little River/Little Haiti/MiMo

The Biohack Lab - Morningside

Set directly on the MiMo/Morningside corridor, this high-tech optimization center bridges a clean aesthetic with heavy cellular repair science — cryotherapy, IV drips and lymphatic drainage tech included.

Symmetry Physical Therapy

Run entirely by clinical Doctors of Physical Therapy on the historic MiMo strip, this premier rehabilitation center focuses on elite athletic alignment via dry needling and neurofunctional movement correction.

The Biostation - MiMo Concierge

An ultra-premium, doctor-led longevity center operating concierge services across the Upper East Side, focused entirely on diagnostic-driven optimization and total biomarker replenishment.

ISHA Beauty & Wellness

This boutique clinical body facility in Little River bypasses general relaxation entirely, focusing on targeted muscular inflammation and structural vascular flush via specialized cryotherapy body sculpting.

Hippy Glow

An intimate, hyper-targeted bodywork studio on the MiMo corridor focused strictly on deep myofascial release and systemic circulation via dry cupping and deep soft-tissue work.

Miami Beach/South Beach/Sunset Harbor

RESET Cryotherapy

A staple in the wellness mecca of Sunset Harbour, with panoramic bay views and a loyal following of local trainers, thanks to BOA Max 2 compression booties and targeted lymphatic drainage tech.

The Standard Spa, Miami Beach

Set on Belle Isle, this hydrotherapy-forward oasis is the ultimate playground for thermal recovery — indoor/outdoor cold plunges, Finnish infrared saunas and a Turkish hammam among the offerings.

VALJALAH Recovery Studio

A sleek, ultra-clean boutique studio on Alton Road focused heavily on precision detox and inflammation control via private medical-grade infrared saunas and contrast cold plunges.

The Shape SPA

Located in South of Fifth, this elite body-work facility is sought after for deep-tissue athletic flush, including wood therapy alongside its 90-minute manual lymphatic drainage massage.

BOSH Physical Therapy

A results-oriented sports medicine center near Lincoln Road, geared toward alignment and injury recovery via neurofunctional cupping therapy and advanced ultrasound tissue regeneration.

Miami River District

UM Sports Medicine Institute Civic Center Miami

The official sports medicine provider for the Miami Hurricanes and the Miami Marlins, this is the gold standard for institutional, medical-grade recovery in the city.

My IV Spa

Located inside the River Landing complex right along the water, all treatments here are guided directly by on-site registered healthcare professionals, from physician-customized IV drips to peptide-driven repair protocols.

South Miami/Pinecrest

USA Sports Therapy - South Miami

This physician-backed powerhouse, trusted by competitive endurance athletes and local sports teams, builds on-demand Theragun myofascial work directly into its manual physical therapy sessions.

SFR Physical Therapy - South Miami

Helmed by expert clinical Doctors of Physical Therapy, this facility focuses on high-performance biometric restoration via advanced sports massage and structural posture correction.

Hawaiian Beauty & Wellness

A results-driven clinical body recovery boutique on Sunset Drive that bypasses basic spa treatments entirely for intense structural muscle unknotting via 90-minute medical sports massage.

Fyzical Therapy & Balance Centers

Formerly known as Physical Therapy Associates, this highly respected institute delivers advanced orthopedic recovery through clinical dry needling and tool-assisted soft-tissue scraping.

Pinecrest Physical Therapy

Directed entirely by licensed clinical Doctors of Physical Therapy, this evidence-based orthopedic practice is heavily relied upon by elite tennis players and local marathoners.

Wynwood/Edgewater/Midtown/Miami Design District

RECVR Midtown

An athlete favorite located right in the heart of Midtown, this elite recovery lounge layers assisted Theragun sessions directly alongside manual sports massage to prevent fascia from re-tightening.

Healthy Longevity Clinic Miami

Located inside the Longevity Lounge at The Moore in the Design District, this ultra-exclusive medical wellness center focuses on reversing biological aging through advanced HBOT and rigorous, physician-guided recovery protocols.

Rewind Anti-Aging of Miami

A premier, physician-led longevity clinic in Wynwood directed by medical doctors, offering peptide tissue-repair injections and precision hormonal optimization for a diagnostic-driven clientele.

Note: This neighborhood cluster currently has 3 listed businesses rather than our usual 5 — flagged for a future pass.

Explore More BE Guides

Miami Recovery: Frequently Asked Questions

What’s an affordable option for trying out different recovery modalities in Miami?

A: You can occasionally find great credit-redemption deals on ClassPass under their “Wellness” section. If you like a certain modality, it’s always worth speaking with the business directly to see if they offer any package discounts on treatments or sessions, which typically yields the best overall price.

Thoughts on lymphatic drainage massage? Any places you would recommend in Miami?

A: My go-to has always been The Shape Spa in Miami Beach. Their practitioners use the Brazilian method, and do a mix of wood tools and cupping along with high-tech add ons like radio frequency for skin tightening. When I first began working out regularly, it was a great way to get a sense of my “progress” by using the massages to encourage my body to flush out the excess water retention.

What’s the most luxe option for recovery treatments?

The Well is a great, reputable brand—they have a membership-only wellness treatment facility as part of their Bay Harbor Island development. They also have a Coconut Grove location opening soon that will be accessible by the general public.

Last Updated: September 2026

Welcome

Welcome to The BE by La Vie de Zee Miami Clean Beauty Guide. “BE” is short for “bien-être,” which means wellbeing in French. It is both a play on the Francophile roots of La Vie de Zee as well as a gentle reminder to prioritize your holistic health. Below, you’ll find a helpful overview of clean, health-forward beauty options in Miami.

Introduction

The clean beauty market has exploded in recent years, with online retailers and service providers alike meeting consumer’s growing needs for products free from harmful synthetic chemicals. Below, we’ve showcased a few of our picks for clean beauty service providers in Miami.

Want an insider’s take on how to navigate clean beauty services in Miami? Jump down to our FAQ section at the end of the article.

Jump to FAQ

Instructions

Our Miami Clean Beauty Discovery Tool invites you to discover clean beauty services around Miami. Filter by neighborhood and service type.

Select a category or neighborhood to explore studios.

Book a Custom Wellness Itinerary

Interested in commissioning a streamlined, insider-informed wellness itinerary for your next trip? Select the button below to request information on booking your private consultation.

Request Information

Miami offers premium options for clean makeup application and non-toxic retail cosmetics, ranging from highly specialized luxury glam studios to vetted clean-beauty retail shelves.

Gee Beauty (Sunset Harbor)

A premier celebrity-favorited studio in Miami Beach specializing in high-tech, results-driven makeup applications. They center their application around their own proprietary Gee Beauty makeup line, built specifically to deliver an effortless, skin-safe, everyday glow without heavy synthetic additives.

Minimal Beauty Skincare (Miami Beach)

An elite holistic skincare clinic that provides skin-conscious event makeup application. They work strictly with fully vetted, organic, and clean-certified makeup formulas to guarantee your pores stay clear and free of toxic chemical irritation during your application.

Bluemercury (Coconut Grove)

A boutique environment that features an extensively curated, physical “Clean at Bluemercury” cosmetic section. It is the best destination in Miami to browse and buy premium, non-toxic cosmetic brands like RMS Beauty, ILIA, and Chantecaille in person.

Sephora (Brickell, Miami Beach, South Miami)

Perfect for a quick restock of popular clean cosmetic mainstays. Their physical “Clean at Sephora” displays enforce strict formulation standards, verifying that products are 100% free of harmful parabens, sulfates, and hidden synthetic phthalates.

Wairua Beauty (Aventura, Miami Beach)

While highly praised for their holistic facials, their storefronts double as fully curated clean-luxury cosmetics boutiques. They stock elite, hard-to-find international non-toxic makeup brands alongside clean skin treatments.

Miami features a premier selection of clean facialists and skin studios that focus exclusively on non-toxic, holistic, and plant-based dermal therapies.

Sana Skin Studio (Aventura, Coconut Grove, Wynwood)

A highly popular, membership-backed clean skin movement. They redefine facials by using strictly non-toxic, goal-driven ingredients paired with client education. Their signature facial pathways treat the skin safely without standard synthetic fillers.

Wairua Beauty (Aventura, Miami Beach)

One of Miami’s top skincare studios specializing in clean beauty brands. Avail yourself of one of their decadent treatments for glowing, hydrated skin.

Daily Habits Wellness Club (Coral Gables)

A curated lifestyle lounge blending high-performance botanical facial sculpting with clean beauty science. They offer specialized treatments like non-toxic buccal facial massages, gua sha, and holistic therapies geared toward resetting irritated skin layers.

ECO Skin Studio (North Miami)

A dedicated facial center built on the baseline foundation that optimal beauty should not damage your body or the ecosystem. They formulate their targeted protocols around certified organic, raw botanical skincare solutions.

Miami Natural Skincare (Miami Beach)

An organic day spa that provides highly customized dermal exfoliation, microneedling, and oxygen therapies utilizing cleanly formulated botanical products.

Miami offers a fantastic selection of clean, sunless tanning boutiques and luxury airbrush services that exclusively utilize eco-certified DHA, plant-based botanicals, and vegan formulas to deliver a streak-free, natural glow without exposure to harsh synthetic dyes, parabens, or typical self-tanner odors.

SUGARED + BRONZED (Midtown Miami)

A premier sunless destination famous for its proprietary, rapid-drying FlexExpress® sunless airbrush solution. Their service is engineered to produce a completely streak-free, ultra-natural faux glow that develops rapidly and fades evenly. They also specialize in all-natural sugaring hair removal using just sugar, lemon, and water.

Ta-Tan! Miami (Midtown)

A top-tier luxury sunless brand praised for custom-blended, hyper-natural airbrush coloring built for models, celebrities, and events. They use a specialized pH-balancing skin primer alongside rapid-rinsing, quick-drying organic ingredients to ensure maximum color longevity.

Glow Up Miami (Midtown Miami)

A highly rated, modern boutique studio known for its cult-favorite, 100% vegan, never-orange formula. They specialize in precise custom color-matching and subtle body contouring, offering both clean studio appointments and premium house-call mobile services.

Katie’s by Katie Becker (Brickell)

A private, specialized airbrush studio that focuses exclusively on clean tanning methods—in addition to providing services like eyelash extensions, lash lifts and eyebrow lamination. Clients praise the studio for its fully organic solution bases that leave behind a seamless, subtle sun-kissed finish without any chemical fragrance or skin tightness.

City Glow Florida (Brickell)

A clean beauty oasis in the heart of Brickell. Alongside their botanical facials and lash treatments, they provide certified clean sunless spray tans customized completely to your skin's baseline tone.

Sobe Tan by Fabiola (Miami Beach)

An iconic, long-standing Miami Beach tanning studio that has worked with numerous celebrities. They have strictly committed to using clean, non-toxic sunless products only for their technician-applied custom airbrush sessions and high-end VersaSpa Pro systems.

Best Miami Tan (Coral Gables)

Tucked inside Flawless by Melissa Fox, this private boutique offers meticulously blended airbrush tans by appointment only. They center their application around clean, skin-safe formulations designed to nourish the skin barrier while developing.

Happy Tanning (Coral Gables)

A dedicated beauty and brow spot that provides hand-sprayed technician-applied organic full body spray tans for a long-lasting, seamlessly blended golden hue.

Sun Tan Miami (Coral Gables)

A highly frequented tanning brand whose popular airbrush services utilize 100% organic custom bronzing solutions that develop in minutes without patchy peeling.

True Tan (Coral Gables)

A dedicated, holistic beauty lounge that explicitly uses ethical, vegan, and 100% organic ingredients. Their hand-sprayed custom airbrush services are highly rated for avoiding harsh chemicals and synthetic additives while ensuring a natural bronze.

LIVTan Miami (Brickell)

Operating out of a private Brickell studio as well as a luxury mobile concierge service, they use custom, clean airbrush blends to achieve a completely natural-looking skin tint directly in your home.

Ellie's Beauty Touch (Brickell)

A luxury beauty service provider offering specialized airbrush tanning utilizing 100% organic, botanical-infused, naturally bronzed solution bases with rapid 3-hour rinse options.

Wairua Beauty (Miami Beach)

This studio is a gold standard for avoiding harmful synthetics. Their specialized body contouring and manual lymphatic drainage massages strictly reject standard synthetic massage gels, mineral oils, and synthetic perfumes. Instead, they use pure, cold-pressed botanical lipids and targeted plant extracts that work seamlessly with your skin's biology.

Leaf Spa at AKA Brickell

Their full-body detox therapies explicitly utilize raw ingredients and certified organic botanicals. They completely swap out synthetic foaming agents (like sulfates) and synthetic chemical exfoliants for clean, earth-derived elements like mineral clays and plant-derived enzymes.

Conventional hair coloring, straightening, and styling products are among the most chemically aggressive segments of the beauty industry, frequently relying on ammonia, formaldehyde-releasing ingredients, resorcinol, and synthetic PPDs to force open the hair cuticle. Applying the same rigorous vetting standard used for body care — screening out high-risk synthetic allergens, endocrine disruptors, and toxic fumes — Miami features a top-tier collection of hair wellness centers and organic salons.

The Root & Bark Organic Hair Salon (Downtown Miami)

A highly specialized, intimate eco-luxury hair studio that operates entirely without standard salon chemical fumes. They work exclusively with The Organic Way (Oway), the beauty industry's premier professional styling and color line formulated entirely with biodynamic, organic, and fair-trade botanical actives. Private studio in Miami, plus dedicated residential travel bookings.

Sayblee Holistic HairGrowth Center (MiMo)

Led by a Certified Trichologist (scalp scientist), this clinic specializes in scalp therapy, thinning hair, and restoration. They explicitly reject synthetic texturizers, parabens, and chemical silicones, instead treating hair using their own patented, 100% plant-based, vegan systems like the Rosemary Clarifying and Lime Nourishing Scalp Healing lines.

Ocean Salon by Gabo Melo (Miami Beach)

Steps from Lincoln Road, this completely fume-free and cruelty-free salon specializes in certified organic coloring. For clients seeking sleek styling without exposure to carcinogenic synthetic gases, they utilize an innovative formaldehyde-free, amino-acid-based organic keratin straightening system that eliminates frizz safely.

Alisados Orgánicos Hair Salón (Coral Gables)

A specialized hair boutique focusing heavily on non-toxic texture modification. Their Alisado Orgánico (Organic Straightening) treatments discard conventional synthetic relaxers in favor of 100% plant-derived moisturizing and volume-reducing acid complexes to smooth hair cleanly.

Miami has several highly-rated nail salons that explicitly prioritize non-toxic, healthy, and conscious hand and foot care.

GLOSS Nail Bar (Coral Gables)

A premier completely non-toxic nail salon on Miracle Mile. They formulate and use their own signature line of all-natural scrubs, mists, and polishes. Their lacquers are guaranteed 10-free, vegan, preservative-free, and fragrance-free, making it a perfect toxic-fume-free zone. They also offer long-lasting, healthy Dazzle Dry systems.

LUV BEAUTY CLUB (Midtown Miami)

A modern, conscious luxury beauty club that strictly bans acrylics, dip powders, and heavy chemical products from their salon. They focus entirely on safe, high-quality products and specialized dry Russian manicures that protect and preserve your natural nail health.

Cilverbow Botanicals (Mobile Only)

A boutique concierge-style natural nail service focusing purely on healthy nail architecture and restoration. They manufacture their own brand of biodynamic, plant-infused hand and foot care products that are fully biodegradable and chemical-free. Salon styling in Miami, plus dedicated mobile service options — no fixed address, so it's featured here as a Miami-wide booking.

Nail Patrol Miami (Mobile Only)

A high-end mobile beauty concept that brings safe, non-toxic manicures and pedicures straight to your home, office, or hotel suite. They use highly vetted, clean products and single-use, customized hygiene kits to ensure full consumer safety without chemical contamination. On-demand across the greater Miami region — no fixed address, so it's featured here as a Miami-wide booking.

A note on where this category is headed: Miami's clean beauty scene is still finding its footing compared to more established markets like New York or Los Angeles. You won't yet find an integrated concept store like Credo or CAP Beauty here, and a handful of the studios above operate by appointment only, without a public storefront to list. We see that as a feature of a growing market, not a flaw in this guide: it reflects exactly where Miami's clean beauty movement stands today, and we'll keep updating it as new additions open their doors.

Frequently Asked Questions: Miami Clean Beauty

Where is the best place to get a clean beauty facial in Miami, Florida?

We love Sana Skin Studio, which offers multiple locations across Miami. Our favorite location is in Coconut Grove, as it is near other great neighborhood spots such as Sadelle’s (great for brunch) and Emissary Café. Wairua Beauty is also a highly-ranked spot to try, featuring top clean beauty lines such as Augustinus Bader and Josh Rosebrook.

DOYA (Wynwood)

Excellent Mediterranean fare with plentiful shareable meze, vegetables, and grilled proteins in the heart of Wynwood.

JaJaJa Mexicana (Wynwood)

Amazing Mexican food that just so happens to be completely vegan! Partake in plant-based street tacos, loaded nachos, and birria burritos in a fun Wynwood space.

Le Jardinier (Miami Design District)

Michelin-starred, vegetable-forward French restaurant sourcing organic produce local farms as well as from its own garden.

Mandolin (Miami Design District)

Like a vacation within a vacation. Charming upscale open-air bistro serving clean, locally sourced Greek and Turkish dishes.

The Vegan Marie (Little Haiti)

An intimate, family-run Little Haiti kitchen serving fully vegan Haitian dishes, with many ingredients sourced straight from the owner's own garden. Feels more like a home kitchen than a restaurant, in the best way.

Aisha's Plant Based Eatery (Downtown Miami)

100% vegan comfort food tucked inside World Famous House of Mac — think plant-based mac and cheese, sliders, and Southern-inspired sides done completely dairy-free.

Naomi’s Garden (MiMo, South Beach)

A taste of the Caribbean. Alongside traditional menu options, this restaurant offers vegan dishes including jerk jackfruit, tofu stroganoff and curry jackfruit.

Avo Miami (Sunset Harbor, Coconut Grove, South Miami) 🥇

Mediterranean-inspired fare made exclusively with zero seed oils, organic ingredients, and grass-fed, pasture-raised proteins. We love their avocado feta toast as well as their freshly-made celery juice—one of the few places in Miami where you can buy it made-to-order!

Carrot Express (Aventura, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, Downtown Miami, Little River, Midtown Miami, Miami Beach, Pinecrest, South Miami, Wynwood)

A mix of decadent treats—like their famous carrot cake—and high-protein salads, macro bowls, and healthy wraps.

Sweetgreen (Aventura, Coconut Grove, Miami Beach, South Miami, Wynwood)

The salad chain that helped popularize the customizable bowl format nationally, now with five Miami locations. Look for antibiotic-free chicken, gluten-free and vegan options, and a genuine commitment to compostable packaging.

Happea's (Brickell)

Mediterranean fast-casual grill known for build-your-own bowls, falafel, and a build-your-own hummus bar. About half the menu is vegan-friendly, with locally sourced ingredients throughout.

Joe & The Juice (Brickell, Miami Beach)

The Copenhagen import known for fresh-pressed juices, quality coffee, and the cult-favorite Tunacado sandwich. A reliable, no-fuss stop for a quick, high-quality bite between errands.

Peel Soft Serve (Miami Shores, Miami Design District)

100% vegan soft serve made from rescued, blemished bananas — proof that dessert can be sustainable without sacrificing flavor. Catch the truck in the Design District, or visit the Miami Shores storefront.

Cure Cafe (Brickell)

A 100% gluten and soy-free health cafe serving organic cold-pressed juices, superfood smoothie bowls, and homemade gluten-free baked goods. A great pick for anyone managing food sensitivities.

GreenLife Organic Bistro (Coral Gables)

A Coral Gables organic cafe known for some of the city's best acai bowls, cold-pressed juices, and hearty organic egg sandwiches. A Giralda Avenue staple for a clean, easy breakfast or lunch.

Apple A Day Cafe (South Beach)

A South Beach breakfast and brunch spot beloved for organic ingredients and gluten-free pizza options — a menu that takes dietary restrictions seriously without sacrificing flavor.

Under the Mango Tree (South Beach)

A bohemian South Beach cafe, quite literally shaded by a mango tree, serving organic acai bowls, fresh smoothies, and vegan sandwiches made with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.

The Cocinita (Brickell) 🥈

A Brickell gem serving a variety of Latin-inspired dishes, all 100% vegan. We love their delicious burgers. A must-visit!

Just Salad (Brickell, Downtown Miami, Midtown Miami)

Enjoy their endlessly-customizable salads and bowls accompanied by vegan proteins like baked tofu. We also enjoy their avocado toasts. A great option for a quick lunch on the go.

Love Life Cafe (Wynwood)

Wynwood plant-based and kosher hot spot known for award-winning vegan burgers and clean, wholesome taco bowls.

Naked Farmer (Downtown Miami)

Farm-to-table counter specializing in locally-grown food with locations across Florida + Charlotte and Nashville. Serving scratch-made vegetables and responsibly raised proteins, with vegan and gluten-free options.

The Plantisserie (Little River)

Enjoy vegan, gluten-free and organic cuisine at The Plantisserie. Dine in or purchase a variety of rotating prepared dishes to take with you.

Pura Vida Miami (Aventura, Bay Harbor Island’s, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, Design District, Edgewater, Miami Beach, North Miami, South Miami)

Perhaps Miami’s most well-known fast-casual café, pairing beautiful interior design and plating with a a variety of plant-forward and protein-rich meals.

Vale Healthy Kitchen (Brickell, Pinecrest)

Fast-casual spot for build-your-own bowls and wraps with clearly labeled gluten-free and vegan options. For a sweet treat, we recommend their açaí bowls, which can be customized with a variety of toppings.

Zak the Baker (Wynwood)

Wynwood's beloved kosher-certified bakery known for handcrafted sourdough and fresh pastries. Stop by after enjoying some of the great workout options nearby.

Nude Miami (Brickell)

Brickell's organic grocer and cafe with a strict no-seed-oil, no-GMO standard across its hot bar, smoothies, and pantry goods.

Glaser Organic Farm Stand (South Miami)

The retail storefront of the family behind the Coconut Grove Saturday market — a certified organic farm stand in South Miami selling raw vegan products, produce, and pantry staples straight from the source.

Vgan Corner Plant-Based Market (Wynwood)

Wynwood's dedicated vegan market and panini bar, stocking 300+ plant-based grocery staples alongside fresh-made sandwiches and a dedicated gluten-free bakery case.

Coconut Grove Farmers Market (Coconut Grove)

Saturday open-air market woven among ancient banyan trees packed with organic produce, vegan food stalls and exotic local fruit.

Legion Park Farmers Market (MiMo)

Enjoy this bayfront local market showcasing independent local growers, sustainable baked goods, and superfoods.

Vizcaya Village Farmers Market (Coconut Grove)

A lively weekly farmer’s market nestled within the historic Vizcaya complex. Beautiful vegetation and friendly local vendors selling everything from raw vegan desserts to bicycle-powered smoothies.

Pinecrest Gardens Farmers Market (Pinecrest)

A Sunday morning market set inside Pinecrest Gardens' lush grounds, with local vendors selling fresh produce and prepared foods in one of Miami's prettiest settings.

Little River Cooperative (Little River)

A five-acre urban farm growing native and edible plants, open weekends for on-site produce sales. A great stop for anyone building out a home garden alongside their grocery list.

Private Chefs

For a more hands-off approach to eating well, these private chef services bring the kitchen to you.

The Pickled Beet (Serving all of Miami)

A boutique personal chef service specializing in medical and autoimmune-friendly diets — think Low FODMAP, Autoimmune Protocol, and Celiac-safe meal planning — for anyone navigating complex dietary needs at home.

Biospan Miami (Serving all of Miami)

A hybrid private chef service and nutrition clinic specializing in 100% organic, grass-finished, and wild whole-food ingredients, with chefs who cook using strictly non-toxic cookware.

The Healthy Kitchen Miami (Serving all of Miami)

Led by Chef Eric Stein, this service blends structured meal programs with personal chef customization and 1-on-1 nutrition coaching, including a signature "YOU 2.0 Detox" program.

Meal Delivery

Ready-to-eat, nutrient-dense meals delivered fresh to your door — no chef required.

Eating By V (Serving all of Miami)

A premium meal delivery program built around a zero seed oil, zero artificial additive standard, with fresh meals delivered twice weekly to preserve quality.

AthleticsFit Miami (Serving all of Miami)

Designed for body recomposition, fat loss, or muscle gain, with meals free of preservatives, GMOs, and antibiotics, plus exact macros verified by staff nutritionists.

Munch Thyme (Serving all of Miami)

A seed-oil-free meal delivery service sourcing from trusted regional suppliers, with a split delivery schedule that keeps every meal — even your Friday one — genuinely fresh.

CSA (Community Supported Agriculture)

Weekly boxes of fresh, organic produce delivered straight from South Florida farms.

Empower Farms CSA (Serving all of Miami)

A certified organic CSA run by a permaculture farm in Florida City that employs people with disabilities, teaching farming skills while delivering weekly boxes of fruit, vegetables, herbs, and eggs across Miami.

Paradise Farms CSA (Serving all of Miami)

A USDA Certified Organic, regenerative farm in Homestead offering seasonal CSA boxes packed with tropical fruits, vegetables, and farm-made staples, with pickup points across Miami or home delivery Miami-Dade-wide.

Just Desserts

Not health food, and we won't pretend otherwise — but a little intentional sweetness has its place too.

The Salty Donut (Wynwood, Coconut Grove, South Miami)

Craft donuts made with real care — always one seasonal gluten-free option, plus rotating vegan flavors, across their Wynwood, Coconut Grove, and South Miami locations.

Miami Nutrition: Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best healthy restaurants in Miami?

“Best” is subjective, but we have our thoughts! We’ve ranked Avo Miami as our #1 healthy restaurant in Miami, based on a combination of credentials (seed oil free, organic, pasture-raised), taste and availability—three locations in our favorite Miami neighborhoods. We also love their fresh celery juice (not pre-bottled!). Avo Miami has it made-to-order.

For comfort food, it’s hard to beat The Cocinita in Brickell. While not necessarily the healthiest option in terms of macros, it provides nutrient dense, high quality, vegan comfort food that tastes amazing and incorporates a variety of Latin flavors. A must-visit for Miami foodies.

For an upscale “date night” vibe, we love Le Jardinier in the Miami Design District (Michelin-starred restaurant with farm-to-table ingredients, many of which come from their own garden).

What are the best healthy lunch spots in Brickell?

There are a variety of fast-casual restaurants with healthy options in Brickell, from Just Salad, Carrot Express, Pura Vida Miami (two, actually!) and more. If you’re looking for a cute lunch spots to enjoy with friends, we recommend either Pura Vida location. If you are pressed for time and need your meal quickly, it’s hard to beat Just Salad, which accommodates a variety of dietary needs (we love their black sesame tofu). Nude Miami Brickell’s hot bar is also an amazing fast option, with custom smoothies and groceries available, as well.

We’re Willing to Drive a Bit Beyond Miami Proper. What Are Some of the Must-Visit Farms and Farmstands?

If you’re willing to make the drive out to Homestead/Redland, there are quite a few great, family-friendly options for fruit stands and markets blending farm-fresh food and entertainment. A few options listed below:

- Robert Is Here Fruit Stand: Family-owned tropical fruit stands and markets with local and exotic produce, smoothies and a petting zoo.
- Redlands Market Village: Large outdoor market with 300+ stalls filed with fresh produce as well as prepared foods and antiques. Open Thursday through Sunday.
- Royd’s at Gateway Farms and Nursery: Enjoy prepared foods made from ingredients sourced from their farm (like their delicious fruit shakes) as well as a plant nursery.
- Paradise Farms Organic: Our top recommendation. Certified organic since 1999 and offers two-hour walking tours of the farm and mushroom facility. Enjoy farm-made refreshments and a small produce stand for visitors.
- Cool Runnings Organic Farm: Urban farm growing fruits and vegetables, with goats, chickens and ducks.

The Best Miami Fitness Studios by Neighborhood

Last Updated: August 2026

Welcome

Welcome to The BE by La Vie de Zee Miami Fitness Guide. Our Miami Fitness Discovery Tool allows you to curate the Miami fitness landscape at a glance to suit your needs. “BE” is short for “bien-être,” which means wellbeing in French. It is both a play on the Francophile roots of La Vie de Zee as well as a gentle reminder to prioritize your holistic health.

Start Your search

Introduction

The Miami wellness scene has been world-renowned for decades—and why shouldn’t it be? Between year-round sunshine, plentiful water activities and more fitness studios than you can shake a palm frond at, the city is having a well-deserved moment as a global health and fitness destination. Since the early 1900s, South Florida has attracted well-heeled Northeasterners looking for a bit of rest and relaxation against a lush, tropical backdrop—especially during the snowier months. Now, many call Miami home year-round and the local wellness industry is booming accordingly.

The Miami fitness scene is truly one-of-a-kind: defined by a mix of enhanced rigor, pulsing music and cutting-edge fashion. Whether you’re a long-time resident, born-and-bred Miamian or flying in for a visit, this curated guide will help you find your favorite workout spots with ease and efficiency.

Instructions

Viewing the tool on desktop? Scroll left-to-right to sort by fitness discipline and up-and-down to see which studios each neighborhood has to offer. Mobile users will see two drop-down menus for Class Types and Neighborhoods, respectively. Make your selections to display matching studio cards.

Want to learn more about the Miami fitness scene before booking your next class? Jump to our comprehensive FAQ section by clicking the button below:

Whether you are looking to try something new or put down roots locally, you will find great fitness options throughout Miami.

Aventura: Premium Wellness Beyond the City Center

This neighborhood is known for its expansive indoor shopping center—Aventura Mall— but there are also great fitness offerings available for those looking to explore movement beyond mall walking. 

The North Coast (Bal Harbour/Surfside/North Miami Beach): Quiet Luxury & Oceanside Movement

This tony, oceanside slip of sand caters to those looking for luxe options with a community feel. Enjoy a workout as well as a visit to the many upmarket shopping and resort destinations in the area, such as The Surf Club and The Shops at Bal Harbour.

Brickell/Downtown Miami: Premium Athletic Clubs & Luxury Gyms

A walkable, high-density concentration of fitness studios and cafés. It’s called “Manhattan South” for a reason. Staying for lunch? Try Pura Vida Miami, Ojo de Agua or specialty grocer Nude Miami for a health-oriented bite.

Coconut Grove/Coral Gables: Leafy Wellness Hubs Meets Historic Charm

Two of the oldest and most venerable neighborhoods in Miami. You’ll find a cross-section of some of the best fitness offerings in the city here. Come on a Saturday to visit the Coconut Grove Farmer’s Market—a must-visit for wellness aficionados.

Key Biscayne/Virginia Key: Coastal Sanctuary Fitness

Key Biscayne’s “laidback luxe” island community offers charming local studios as well as outposts of larger fitness chains. Virginia Key is the site of a plethora of water activities and is one of Miami’s most cherished natural resources. Bring chairs and towels for a relaxed beach day, picking up coffee and pastries at Flour and Weirdoughs on your way to the sand. ⛱️

Little River/Little Haiti/MiMo: Emerging Indie Studios and Creative Concepts

A more recent addition to Miami’s wellness neighborhoods, these areas are home to studios offering style and substance in equal measure. Try a late afternoon or evening class, followed by dinner at La Natural or Sunny’s.

Miami River District: Urban Waterfront Wellness

Just west of Brickell lies a vibrant community offering both new and established fitness studios worth visiting. If you’re coming via the Miami River, you’re likely familiar with Casa Neos, Seaspice and Kiki on the River.

Miami Beach/South Beach/Sunset Harbor: High-Density, World-Renowned Fitness Hub

The traditional heart of Miami’s wellness scene. Steps away from both the beach and the bay, it’s difficult not to stumble into one of the many top-tier fitness offerings you’ll find in this area. Take advantage of your proximity to some of Miami Beach’s finest resorts to enjoy a rooftop lunch at Watr at 1 Hotel or a bayfront brunch at The Standard.

South Miami/Pinecrest: Family-Oriented Neighborhood Replete with Local Gems

Residential and family-focused, as well as abundant in top fitness offerings. Spend time enjoying the nature of the Fairchild Botanical Gardens nearby, or the grounds of the nationally-acclaimed Deering Estate.

Wynwood/Edgewater/Midtown/Miami Design District: Cutting-Edge Concepts and Trendy Studios

Hip, centrally-located and design-forward—you’ll find plenty of spots for both a sweat and a selfie. Stop by the Alo store in the Miami Design District for a fresh workout set and On Running for a pair of sneakers. Mandolin just down the way is one of our favorite restaurants in Miami, with plenty of healthy Mediterranean fare.

Aerial

Defy gravity with these graceful, strength-building classes. Under the supervision of a trained instructor, use silks to suspend your body off of the ground in various positions. Go to Aerial Studios.

Barre

Looking for a burn that activates those smaller, frequently-overlooked muscle groups? These studios have just the workout for you. Use ballet-inspired movements to target and tone for an effective full-body workout. Go to Barre Studios.

Boxing 

Get those fists flying and your heart rate up at a high-energy boxing or kickboxing class. Use combat-inspired moves set to uptempo music to hone coordination and strength. Go to Boxing Studios.

Gyms

For longer stays and Miami residents, premium gyms offer a dynamic mix of classes, equipment and opportunities for social connection. Go to Gyms.

Heated & Infrared Workouts

Amplify the effects your workouts courtesy of infrared heat for a higher calorie burn and improved cardiovascular benefits. Go to Heated Workouts.

HIIT & Strength Training Studios

Challenge yourself with these workouts designed to build strength and cardiovascular endurance.  Go to HIIT & Strength Training Studios.

Lagree & Reformer Strength Training

Challenge yourself with a spicy, strength-focused workout at one of Miami’s many celebrated reformer strength training studios. Go to Lagree & Reformer Strength Training Studios.

Pickleball, Padel, Paddleboarding & Kayaking

These outdoor sports are a great way to incorporate movement, socialize, and enjoy the Miami sunshine. Go to Pickleball, Padel, Paddleboarding & Kayaking.

Pilates (Mat, Contemporary, Classical Reformer, Cadillac, Tower)

From longstanding, “old-school” establishments to trendy hotspots, you’ll be spoiled for choice. Go to Pilates Studios.

Stretching 

Pre-and-post-movement body care is essential for preventing injury and promoting longevity. These studios can help! Go to Stretching Studios.

Yoga

Looking to enhance your alignment, balance, stability and flexibility? There are a plethora of top studios in Miami to support your practice. Go to Yoga Studios.

Ready to book your next class? You will find links to each studio’s booking portals below. We’ve ranked our favorite studios per category (🥇🥈🥉) and added a spicy chili (🌶️) next to studios that are known for featuring challenging classes.

Aerial Studios

Libre Aerial Fitness + Pilates (Wynwood)

Stretch and soar in this beautiful studio. Intentional design meets luxe amenities. Infrared heated classes available.

Break Free Movement (Coral Gables) 🌶️

Explore a mix of heated yoga, sculpt and mat Pilates and aerial fitness classes at this well-respected studio located in the heart of Coral Gables.

Art In Movement (Brickell)

This studio features Aerial Pilates, classes taught in Spanish and Reformer Pilates. Stay tuned for Kinam classes: a discipline derived from the psychophysical techniques practiced by Mexican shamans.

RF Studios (Miami Beach)

This studio offers aerial classes performed on neon green silks in addition to a host of other fitness offerings.

Lure Studio (Wynwood)

For those looking for an aerial-focused studio with a range of class offerings, look no further.

Barre Studios

Posh Life Pilates (Miami River District)

This riverfront studio offers Barre, Mat Pilates and Reformer Pilates classes. The details—like the clear acrylic barre and the custom pink Reformers—make each visit even more special.

Pure Barre Miami (Coral Gables, Midtown)

This is one of the nation's most popular barre franchises for a reason. Guaranteed to inspire a serious case of the shakes.

The Bar Method (South Miami)

Cultivate your inner strength at The Bar Method South Miami—conveniently located in a pedestrian-friendly shopping area.

The.Only.Studio (Bay Harbor Island)

A chic barre and sculpt studio in the heart of Bay Harbor Island.

Boxing Studios

CKO Kickboxing (Brickell)

Elevate your heart rate and learn kickboxing techniques from pro fighters.

Gotham Gym (Sunset Harbor) 🥇

Take a class at this Sunset Harbor stalwart, which has been home to some of Miami's top boxing instructors for years. Practice your movement in the ring, strike the bag, and work on your cardiovascular conditioning.

Rumble Boxing (Coral Gables) 🥈

Enjoy a high-energy group boxing class suitable for beginners and experts alike. Perfect for bringing a friend.

Gyms

Anatomy (South Beach, Sunset Harbor, Coconut Grove, Midtown, Aventura, Doral) 🥇

Anatomy is the gold standard of high-end studios in Miami. Enjoy a range of classes, a broad selection of equipment, and premium amenities (which vary by location).

Equinox (Brickell, Brickell Heights, South Beach)

This luxury gym chain is known for its pro-social atmosphere. Enjoy chats by the pool (select locations) and work spaces in addition to top-notch classes and equipment.

Life Time Miami (Coral Gables)

This expansive gym located at the intersection of Coconut Grove and Coral Gables offers world-class amenities and co-working opportunities.

Heated & Infrared Studios

Mimi Yoga & Pilates 🥇 (Wynwood, Coconut Grove, Aventura)

This studio is known for its excellent classes, beautiful aesthetics, great locations and engaging instructors. Truly a must-visit on any wellness trip to Miami.

Long Lean Pilates (Downtown Miami)

This studio offers a mix of heated and non-heated Mat Pilates and sculpt classes, as well as small group Reformer Pilates classes.

Sweat Studio Miami (North Miami Beach)

Work up a sweat in one of their heated Mat Pilates classes. This studio also offers a Reformer/Mat Pilates combo class.

HIIT & Strength Training

AIRLAB Fitness (Coral Gables, Midtown Miami)

This HYROX gym allows participants to train in conditions simulating high altitudes, increasing blood oxygenation and overall performance.

Barry's (Aventura, Midtown, Sunset Harbor)

This iconic Barry's location is a Sunset Harbor institution. Challenge yourself in the infamous Red Room and replenish with a protein smoothie afterwards at their Fuel Bar.

BÜNDA (Coral Gables, Edgewater, Pinecrest)

This stairclimber-meets-HIIT workout class is perfect for lower body enthusiasts.

F45 Training (Aventura, Brickell, Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Pinecrest)

With structured group classes and locations around Miami, F45 Training is a great way to build a consistent strength training routine.

GluteHouse (Brickell)

As the name implies, a specialized circuit training membership designed to help you build one of your body's largest muscle groups.

Omega Wellness Club (Wynwood)

This all-purpose gym boasts a variety of strength training and functional fitness classes as well as a traditional gym setup.

Raw 305 (Edgewater)

These classes focus on form and results, with top-of-the-line equipment and a personal training feel.

Sweat440 (Aventura, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Miami Beach, Midtown Miami, North Miami, Pinecrest, South Miami)

With classes famously beginning every 10 minutes, you never have to worry about being late again. Just show up, and get your sweat on.

Lagree & Reformer Strength Training Studios

Beau Monde Pilates (Miami Beach)

Visit their South of Fifth studio to take classes on their custom machines that look and feel like a blend of a megaformer, a Tower, and a classic Pilates Reformer.

Form50 (Wynwood) 🌶️

This studio is favored by fitness enthusiasts, influencers and Sports Illustrated models alike.

JetSet Pilates (Edgewater, Brickell, Downtown Miami, South Beach, Coral Gables, North Miami Beach, Coconut Grove, Sunset Harbor, Aventura) 🌶️

This "modern" spin on Pilates features high resistance and plenty of spicy proprietary moves.

Megaformer Studio (Sunset Harbor) 🌶️🥇

Co-owned by Sebastien Lagree, the founder of The Lagree Method. One of Miami's toughest workouts.

Megalit (Wynwood)  

A longtime licensee of the Lagree Method in Miami. This studio also features boxing and yoga.

[solidcore] (Brickell, Sunset Harbor, Pinecrest*, Coral Gables) 🌶️

A "solid" workout that promises deep core activation each time. Pinecrest location coming soon.

Tremble (Aventura, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, Key Biscayne, Miami Beach, Midtown Miami, Pinecrest, South Miami)

Somewhere between Solidcore and Reformer Pilates (the machines have straps for "feet in straps moves"), they don't call this studio "tremble" for nothing.

Pickleball, Padel, Paddleboarding & Kayaking

PADL

PADL hosts a number of self-service paddleboard rental sites strategically placed around Miami. Just unlock via the app and hit the water. Select sites also offer guided experiences, kayaking, waterfoil and more.

Padel X Miami (Downtown Miami)

For those looking to invest in the social benefits of padel, Padel X Miami is an excellent choice. Memberships are structured to encourage both networking and playful competition.

Ultra Padel Club (Aventura, Midtown)

Ultra Padel boasts high-tech courts, premium amenities (think: cold plunge) and dining, making it a true wellness lifestyle destination.

Wynwood Padel Club

A vibrant community in the heart of one of Miami's most vibrant neighborhoods. Enjoy the on-site smoothie bar as well as competitive game play and tournaments.

Pilates Studios

CadiLab Pilates (Coral Gables) 🥇

Pro tip: Try one of their signature Tower classes for a Classical Pilates experience that your spine will love. B

Eleven Pilates (Downtown Miami)

A must-visit for Pilates purists. An authentic classical boutique Pilates studio.

Forrest Pilates (Miami River District)

A laid back classical Pilates studio tucked into a tropical oasis minutes away from the Miami River.

Long Lean Pilates (Downtown Miami) 

Choose from a mix of heated or non-heated Mat Pilates classes, as well as small group Reformer Pilates classes.

Miami Pilates (Aventura, Wynwood)

This uber-chic studio features both Cadillac and Reformer Pilates classes.

Miami Pilates Company (Downtown Miami)

This vibrant Pilates studio supports a diverse community, with classes that will see you progress in skill over time. Read our interview with founder Michelle Roques here.

Mimi Yoga & Pilates (Aventura, Coconut Grove, Wynwood)🌶️

One of Miami's premier hot yoga and Mat Pilates studios. Treat yourself to excellent instructors, attentive staff, infrared heat and stunning interior design.

Palmi Sano Wellness (Wynwood)

This studio in Wynwood embraces the neighborhood's creativity-forward vibe, featuring innovative classes and events.

Pilathon (Little River, Wynwood)

A great choice for practitioners passionate about their Pilates practice. Take a group class or invest in a private class with the owner to take your skills to the next level.

Posh Life Pilates (Miami River District)

Pilates at Posh Life is an experience. Round out your wellness routine with a visit to their in-house infrared sauna. Mat, Reformer and Barre classes available.

Reforming Pilates (Brickell, Bay Harbor Island, Miami Beach)

A Miami cultural institution with a pedigreed clientele to match. The aesthetics draw you in, but the community keeps you coming back.

727 Pilates

Treat yourself to a full body reset at 727 Pilates, which features Reformer Pilates, Mat Pilates, an infrared sauna and cold plunge.

Stretching Studios

Stretch Lab (Midtown Miami, Pinecrest)

Stretching is an essential part of preventing injury and boosting circulation. Stretch Lab sessions help promote mobility and flexibility.

Stretch Zone (Aventura, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, North Miami Beach, South Beach, South Miami )

New to assisted stretching? Your first 30-minute stretch is free.

Yoga Studios

Casa Vinyasa (Coral Gables)

Mix up your practice with classes like Steel Mace Vinyasa.

Core Lab Wellness (Key Biscayne)

An unheated yoga and sculpt studio featuring challenging classes in an intimate space.

Core Power Yoga (Brickell)

Try a free heated community yoga class offered on Sundays. Filming and non-filming classes available. Locations in Coral Gables and Midtown coming soon.

Ima Yoga (Sunset Harbor)

Heated and non-heated classes located in prime Sunset Harbor. Drop by Pura Vida around the corner for a post-class refresher.

Mimi Yoga & Pilates (Aventura, Coconut Grove, Wynwood)

More than a fitness studio — a yoga lifestyle community led by yogi Mimi Ghandour.

Open Door Yoga (Coconut Grove)

Enjoy personalized attention and calming ambiance at this studio in The Grove.

Sol Yoga (Sunset Harbor)  🥈

This studio offers heated yoga, Mat Pilates and sculpt classes. Enjoy a post-class smoothie from their in-house smoothie bar.

Skanda Yoga (Brickell) 🥇

Beloved by hard-core yogis. Broaden your asana practice with classes focusing on alignment, breathwork and functional movement.

Tondo Room (Key Biscayne)

Come for the high vibrations, stay for the community. Keep an eye out for the occasional oceanside event.

Wild Thing

This vibe-y, nature-inspired studio offers a mix of heated-and non heated yoga and Mat Pilates classes.

YO BK (Wynwood) 🥉

Enjoy yoga and Pilates classes at this vibrant wellness hub in the heart of Wynwood. Keep an eye out for special event partnerships.

Yoga Joint (Coral Gables, Midtown Miami)

Try this popular infrared heated yoga studio, with sister studios located around the country.

Miami Fitness: Frequently Asked Questions

While the Miami fitness landscape is not a monolith, there are certain common themes that are helpful to know before making your first booking or committing to a studio. Below, we answer a few frequently-asked questions:

Q: Do I need to bring grip socks to Pilates or barre classes?

For most studios, the answer is YES. The primary exception is Mat Pilates, which is typically performed barefoot like yoga. Some smaller independent studios may allow you to take class without socks. Private sessions where the machines are cleaned between clients are also more likely to be lenient. But in general: bring your own grip socks or be prepared to purchase a pair at the front desk.

Q: Are the classes harder?

Anecdotally, the group fitness classes in Miami are much harder than the classes you would find in other markets, even within the same studio franchise. Miami fitness is notoriously tough, as the clientele is demanding and competition is fierce. If you are beginner or just getting back into movement, working with a private trainer or taking beginner-focused classes may be the best way to ease yourself in.

Q: What is the Miami fitness studio vibe like? Laid-back? Friendly?

On a scale from Deep South to New York City, Miami is somewhere in the middle. You likely won’t start chatting with the person on the reformer next to you immediately, but clients also aren’t power-walking out the door the minute class ends. If connection is your goal, finding a studio, class time and instructor you like and showing up a few times consistently is a good way to connect with other regulars. Initiating conversation and offering to purchase an after-class bev is always a great way to show friendly interest.

Q: What are the best Pilates studios in Miami?

Miami has a plethora of great Pilates studios. The answer in terms of “best studios” is a nuanced one—one that depends on your goals and preferred class type. We’ll start by saying that to truly get a full Pilates experience, nothing beats a private class with a well-trained, highly-certified instructor. For group classes, including our favorites below:

-For Cadillac/Tower classes: CadiLab in Coral Gables
-For Classical Pilates: Club Pilates
-For Contemporary, “athletic-style” Pilates classes performed on an Allegro 2 machine: -Pilathon and Reforming Pilates
-For a Classical Reformer/Cadillac/Tower “split”: NoFar Method in Miami Beach
-For Infrared (“Hot”) Classical Mat Pilates: Mimi Yoga & Pilates in Wynwood
-For Unheated Classical Mat Pilates: Long Lean Pilates in Downtown Miami
-For “Pilates-Inspired” classes: Tremble or JetSet Pilates

Q: I’m living/staying in Brickell. What are my options re: luxury gyms?

I’ll start off with a Miami local pro-tip: as convenient as Brickell is, to truly get all of the best amenities under one roof, you’re better off expanding your range to the Anatomy location just outside of Brickell in Coconut Grove or LifeTime Fitness in Coral Gables. However, if you need something nearby, you have great options in the form of Equinox Brickell and Equinox Brickell Heights. For residents, many buildings have their own gyms with amenities that rival local gym offerings (and are included with the price of rent/condo ownership).

Q: Where are the best neighborhoods to work out in Miami?

If we are talking pure density, it’s hard to argue against Sunset Harbor and the Wynwood/Midtown/Edgewater corridor. A high concentration of some of the top studios and gyms, as well as other wellness amenities nearby like cafés for iced coffees, matchas and protein shakes as well as athletic apparel stores like On and Alo.

In terms of outdoor workouts, anywhere near the beach or the bay is a great way to get steps in and see beautiful nature, with the added benefit of a nice, cooling breeze.

Ultimately, the best place to workout in Miami is going to be the place where you show up regularly! Finding a good neighborhood spot that you can get to without battling traffic is a smart first step.
